name: basics: take inventory of the workflows on the instance
description: Tier 3, live Galaxy. What a researcher asks on arriving: what workflows are here, and which relate to my assay. The subject filter is the hard part -- Galaxy's own ?search drops raw terms under four characters, so delegating 'rna seq' to it matches every workflow, and a naive name substring matches none. Asks about the workflows this scenario stages rather than the server's total: the instance is shared and accumulates workflows from other work, so a global count is not the scenario's to assert. The subject filter is still the hard part.
inputs: I have five workflows saved for this project: RNA-seq quantification (paired-end), RNAseq differential expression, Germline variant calling, ChIP-seq peak calling, and Read quality control and trimming. How many of those five relate to RNA-seq?
Name those ones, and tell me how many steps each has.
